main_text.p: exquisitè vacuato. Nam hæc in oculum vapores nouos, & aquas largiores, qua vi dige runt, etiam traherent. Admonentur autem primò clementiora (quo ipse oculus sensu tactus exacto præditus, paulatim etiam valentioribus remedijs assuescat) vt, fœniculi, ruta aqua, vel succus per resident[?]ia purgatus: aqua ex melle destillata: Hæc enim mirè terget albuginem ac maculas oculi, & facici. Idem præstat puluis sacchari candi à multis probatus. Sagapenum quoque ad hypochy-fes resoluendas admotum, efficacissimum do-cet Auic. cap. de sagapeno: quod verum probabis ipsum dissoluens vino granatorum, vel aqua rosarum, fœniculi, mellis destillati, & lacte, & albo oui cum saccharo cando, vt oculus sagapeno soli paulatim assuescat. Idem præstat Auicennæ puluis capitum hirundinum: eandem siccat vrina pueri nondum polluti cum pauco fœniculo destillata, vt seruari diutius incorrupta possit, nec oleat grauiter. Balsamum quoque ob eius penuriam vsurarum, eas etiam siccat, et oculum sanitati pristinæ restituit.

page.notes: Marginal text at left edge is partly illegible show-through and was not transcribed. Some words in the text are uncertain due to the italic type ("resident[?]ia" is a probable reading). "Ossis" at the foot is a closing word, set right-aligned; transcribed as a paragraph.
